column2: The herd has grown, and the mightiest beasts of the forest answer the call of the brayhorn. Which of them will march at your side?
Young gors gather at the herdstone, eager to prove themselves. Which of them will join your warherd?
Your fame has spread across the Wastes, and monsters and champions come to fight under your banner. Which will you take?
Warriors of the tribes gather at your camp, hoping to earn the favour of the gods in your service. Which of them will you take?

The old chieftain is dead, and the herd has gathered around [From.GetFirstName], who claims the herd as [From.GetHerHis] birthright. Birthright! The gods care nothing for blood, only for strength. Half the gors are already looking at you.

[From.GetFirstName] pushed through the herd and stood before you, snorting, while every gor waited for the challenge. Then [From.GetSheHe] lowered [From.GetHerHis] horns and knelt. The herd brays your name.

You are walking the edge of the warcamp among the hedgerows of the Moot when something rustles in the brambles. A halfling steps out, no taller than your belt, a dagger in each hand and murder in his eyes. "That was my uncle's farm you burned," he says, and charges.
You kill the halfling and the herd hears of it.
The halfling gets his daggers into you before he flees.
The Chaos moon hangs full and green above the forest, and the herdstones hum. Every beast in the woods feels it: the hunger, the fury, the call of the Dark Gods. This is a year for blood.

Morrslieb, the Chaos moon, hangs full and green in the night sky. Mothers bar their doors, priests pray through the night, and from the deep forests comes the braying of the herds. Travellers speak of warherds gathering and of children born with horns.

[beastmen_shaman.GetFirstName] cut open a goat at the herdstone and read its entrails, then threw back [beastmen_shaman.GetHerHis] head and brayed. The signs are clear: the gods are hungry, and the herd has grown fat on peace. They want blood, and they want it soon.
Then we march on the soft ones!
We will feed them in the next fight.

For three nights the herdstone has sung, a low hum that sets the gors' teeth on edge and makes the ungors fight in the mud. [beastmen_shaman.GetFirstName] says the stone is full of power and that the herd must gather before it wanes.
Gather the herd for a great rite.
Gather the herd for a feast!
The entrails came out black and stinking, and the crows flew west. [beastmen_shaman.GetFirstName] says the gods are angry with the herd. Only a sacrifice will turn their anger aside.
The Chaos moon is full, and the herds are wild with fury.
The bray shaman has read a call to war in the signs.
The gods are angry, and the herd knows it.
The herdstone hums with the power of a great rite, and the beasts of the forest gather to it.
